result:
I fixed the regression. In `anthrouter/http_util.py`, the request-count header was misspelled as `anthropic-ratelimit-request-remaining`. Anthropic's header is `anthropic-ratelimit-requests-remaining`, with an "s". Because of the typo, `requests_remaining` was never parsed, so it was never recorded.

I ran only the rate-limit tests (6 passed) and `tests/test_db.py`, `tests/test_admin.py` and `tests/test_handlers.py`. I did not run the full suite. In those three files, 225 tests passed and 2 failed. The two failures are both in `tests/test_handlers.py`:
- `test_cached_tier_is_not_replayed_into_a_different_requested_tier`
- `test_locked_baseline_scopes_the_tier_slot_by_the_lock`

Both concern the routing cache (the expected `session_cached_tier` reason code didn't come back) and nothing about rate limits, so I treated them as earlier failures and left them alone. I didn't check them against the original commit to confirm.
